svg.title: Northern Development Initiative Trust — Northern Development logo, horizontal, 2024 Annual Report
svg.desc: Native vector artwork cut from the front cover (PDF page 1) of the trust's Annual Report 2024 (PDF created 2 May 2025): the square symbol, whose two gradients are the PDF's own shadings inside vector clips, beside NORTHERN DEVELOPMENT in white, as printed on the cover's navy. Converted to SVG by Poppler's pdftocairo; only drawing outside the logo is removed. No tracing, retyping or raster. White lettering, for a dark ground.
